$comment: Schema/manifest of the SSM Parameter Store entries required by UZEX Data Agent V2.1. This file contains NO secret value. Populate values interactively with deploy/aws/publish-ssm-parameters.sh.

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/postgres_password
parameters.purpose: PostgreSQL owner password; used only by the db and migration/import services

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/reader_password
parameters.purpose: Password for the SELECT-only uzex_reader runtime role

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/app_secret
parameters.purpose: Application secret used by the backend

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/groq_api_key_secondary
parameters.purpose: Same-scope credential redundancy; never used to bypass HTTP 429

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/groq_api_key_secondary_same_org
parameters.purpose: Same-scope credential redundancy; never used to bypass HTTP 429

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/groq_api_key_tertiary_same_org
parameters.purpose: Same-scope credential redundancy; never used to bypass HTTP 429

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/groq_organization_scope_id
parameters.purpose: Real shared Groq organization scope; placeholders are rejected by render-env.sh

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/groq_project_scope_id
parameters.purpose: Real shared Groq project scope; placeholders are rejected by render-env.sh

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/planner_mode
parameters.purpose: local | llm; enable llm only after the 112-case qualification passes

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/web_port
parameters.purpose: Public web port published by the web container; 80/443 are the only public ports

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/cors_origins
parameters.purpose: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API directly

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/dataset_cutoff_date
parameters.purpose: Dataset cutoff enforced by evidence validation

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/llm_fallback_chain
parameters.purpose: provider:model list; empty by default because unqualified fallbacks are never built

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/llm_plan_critic_mode
parameters.purpose: off | risk_based; risk_based may only narrow a plan, never add facts

parameters.name: /uzex/prod/llm_rag_enabled
parameters.purpose: true | false; enable only after the RAG ON/OFF evaluation proves improvement
